comment: The clips the pose database is made of (Tools\pose-prior.ps1 -Build): recorded poses of standing, stepping, crouching, sitting, being pushed and felled, lying and getting up. A chosen part of the sample, by the owner's decision of 25 November 2026. A wider set (sprints, slides, traversal) would make almost any pose look like some recorded one. Patterns are regular expressions on a clip's file name; 'folder' is below Content/Characters (in_project) or below the sample's Animations folder (from_sample, copied by Tools\fetch-sample-anims.ps1). Every set names the number of clips it is expected to give: another number is an error, since figures from two databases are not to be compared.
